summary_1line: Sudarsana’s extreme guest‑hospitality is tested by Dharma, earning divine praise and victory over Death; the narrative shifts as Yudhishthira asks how Vishvamitra became a Brahmana.

image_candidates.scene_text: Sudarsana calmly tells the Brahmana guest to enjoy his wife as a sacred duty of hospitality while Death stands nearby with an iron club.
The Brahmana guest emerges from the hut and reveals himself as Dharma, radiating power as the air resounds with Vedic echoes.
Indra arrives in a blazing chariot drawn by a thousand white horses as the righteous householder is praised by the gods.
